sweep.note: sweep/<side>.tsv keeps the harness line of every cell; the JSON dumps hold the same lines with timings and are not copied.

paths.note: Per cell: normalized outcome, error code, result summary, canonical sha256 of the raw response without the probe field, violation trace, probe, IR sha256 and normalized IR sha256. The final dumps (paths-r6) also hold wire (sha256 of the response text with the probe member cut out), publishedWire and compileText. The final dumps (paths-r8, with the probe that serializes published256 through the product serializer) also hold programWire (raw program text digest).

r5Dumps.note: the dumps of the first complete evaluation (before the driver recorded response-byte digests); superseded by finalDumps below

r6Dumps.note: dumps with response-byte digests but with the key-sorted published256; superseded by finalDumps

auditReduction.note: raw logs, per-point and per-cell outputs and scratch outputs moved out of the committed set into the untracked target/0120-audit-raw/ with the same relative paths; the logs of every command are summarised by commands.tsv (exit, outcome, peak RSS, wall time).

heldSteps.note: outputs of the held steps (4-path rerun, example C against TLC, evaluator-corpus, temporal-parity, kernel Criterion, just recipes). They are under the untracked target/0120-audit-raw/ with the same relative paths; the digests are for someone holding them.
